review_method: Inspected primary report section structures, proposal catalogues and candidate-relevant arguments; indexed every placed packet a-w and all five incoming manuscripts.
Reuse the prior120-entry exclusion ledger as an attributed index; cross-check its mechanism list against the primary manuscripts and focused supporting notes/prototypes.
Search accessible note/code/patch text and hash-verified v/w supplements for candidate-specific terms and close mathematical mechanisms.
Read current intake README Lean sections and the adoption record; preserve pending/deferred/optional proposals in the exclusion set.
limitations: The 1292-entry Git inventory is a filename/blob inventory, not a claim that every log, historical source snapshot, binary PDF and every archive member was read semantically.

The first materialized checkout had disk-induced truncation in v report fragments and some provenance JSON. The audit uses separately downloaded exact-hash primary text for v/w; the corrupted local files are not evidence.
Archived PDFs were not separately rendered; the delivered LaTeX sources were used for manuscript inspection.
Novelty is assessed against this pinned corpus, not all past conversations or the entire literature.
Proposals are assumed applied as compatible mathematical contracts; no synthetic checkout combining all conflicting earlier patches was built.
